title: GE Evolution 柴電機車
summary: 以「GE Evolution 柴電機車」為案例，逐步分析柴電機車的發電、牽引與附著管理。十個單元各有機制、定量、驗證與診斷；所有數字是教學假設，共用物理模型依案例介面選用；列車質量例題指一節虛擬車廂，非完整編組。
summaryEn: Use GE Evolution diesel-electric locomotive to analyze Generation, traction and adhesion management of a diesel-electric locomotive. Ten units connect mechanisms, calculations, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are teaching assumptions; shared physical models are selected for the case interfaces. Train mass examples concern one virtual car, not a full formation.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

steps.title: 使用需求與試驗邊界｜GE Evolution 柴電機車：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Use requirements and test boundary | GE Evolution diesel-electric locomotive: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 使用需求與試驗邊界｜GE Evolution 柴電機車 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Use requirements and test boundary | GE Evolution diesel-electric locomotive and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 案例任務：柴電機車的發電、牽引與附著管理。本單元觀察 柴油機、發電機、功率模組及輪端 中與「使用需求與試驗邊界」相關的介面。車型名稱不是試驗條件；先把乘員、貨物、續航與地形需求轉成載荷表。整車的輸入質量必須包含結構、能源系統及使用載荷。
steps.instructionEn: Case task: Generation, traction and adhesion management of a diesel-electric locomotive. In diesel engine, generator, power modules and wheel ends, inspect the interface related to “Use requirements and test boundary”. A vehicle name is not a test condition. Convert occupants, cargo, range and terrain needs into a load table; input mass must include structure, energy storage and operating payload.
steps.observation: 明示教學假設，不是 GE Evolution 柴電機車 的原廠或實測規格。m_total=m_empty+m_payload；假設空車 102000 kg、載荷 18000 kg。 計算結果 = 120000 kg。此為獨立教學工況；跨單元整合前先統一輸入、邊界及能量分配，再依模型限制解讀。
steps.observationEn: Explicit teaching assumptions, not manufacturer or measured specifications for GE Evolution diesel-electric locomotive. m_total=m_empty+m_payload; assume empty mass 102000 kg and payload 18000 kg. Result = 120000 kg. This is an independent teaching operating point; reconcile inputs, boundaries and energy allocation before integrating units, then interpret within the model limits.
steps.failure: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。
steps.failureEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions.
steps.check: 核對每一項載荷只計入一次；用同一資料版本計算空載與滿載，保留被排除的拖車、乘員或附件。 將證據連回本案例的 柴油機、發電機、功率模組及輪端，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
steps.checkEn: Check that every load is counted once; calculate empty and laden conditions from the same data version and list excluded trailers, people or accessories. Link evidence to this case’s diesel engine, generator, power modules and wheel ends; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.

knowledge.textEn: Complete in a paper diagram, spreadsheet or separately prepared offline teaching model: Create a requirement-to-measurement-to-condition-to-acceptance matrix and identify one performance claim that the available evidence cannot establish. Label the evidence c249, unit 1, input conditions and data version.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
車名相同就可以直接沿用另一年份的重量與試驗條件。
optionsEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
The same model name permits weight and test conditions from another model year to be reused.
quiz.explanation: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。 核對每一項載荷只計入一次；用同一資料版本計算空載與滿載，保留被排除的拖車、乘員或附件。 將證據連回本案例的 柴油機、發電機、功率模組及輪端，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
quiz.explanationEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions. Check that every load is counted once; calculate empty and laden conditions from the same data version and list excluded trailers, people or accessories. steps.title: 柴電能量轉換與牽引鏈｜GE Evolution 柴電機車：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Diesel–electric conversion and traction chain | GE Evolution diesel-electric locomotive: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 柴電能量轉換與牽引鏈｜GE Evolution 柴電機車 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Diesel–electric conversion and traction chain | GE Evolution diesel-electric locomotive and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 案例任務：柴電機車的發電、牽引與附著管理。本單元觀察 柴油機、發電機、功率模組及輪端 中與「柴電能量轉換與牽引鏈」相關的介面。柴電傳動依序經熱機、發電機、功率轉換器與牽引馬達，串聯系統的效率相乘；它不是把電傳動當成無損齒輪。
steps.instructionEn: Case task: Generation, traction and adhesion management of a diesel-electric locomotive. In diesel engine, generator, power modules and wheel ends, inspect the interface related to “Diesel–electric conversion and traction chain”. Diesel–electric transmission passes through engine, generator, converter and traction motor, multiplying efficiencies along the chain rather than treating electric transmission as a lossless gear.
steps.observation: 明示教學假設，不是 GE Evolution 柴電機車 的原廠或實測規格。P_wheel=P_engine η_gen η_drive；假設引擎機械輸出 1e6 W、η_gen=0.94、η_drive=0.90。 計算結果 = 846000 W。此為獨立教學工況；跨單元整合前先統一輸入、邊界及能量分配，再依模型限制解讀。
steps.observationEn: Explicit teaching assumptions, not manufacturer or measured specifications for GE Evolution diesel-electric locomotive. P_wheel=P_engine η_gen η_drive; assume engine mechanical output 1e6 W, η_gen=0.94 and η_drive=0.90. Result = 846000 W. This is an independent teaching operating point; reconcile inputs, boundaries and energy allocation before integrating units, then interpret within the model limits.
steps.failure: 引擎輸出正常而牽引下降，分查發電、轉換器、馬達限流與附著；不能只增加燃料輸入。
steps.failureEn: Normal engine output with weak traction requires generator, converter, motor-current and adhesion checks rather than only more fuel.
steps.check: 每一站的功率都要標明電／機械邊界及輔機；核對損失總和等於輸入輸出差，不重複套效率。 將證據連回本案例的 柴油機、發電機、功率模組及輪端，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
steps.checkEn: Label electrical/mechanical boundaries and auxiliaries at each station; ensure summed losses equal input minus output without applying efficiency twice. Link evidence to this case’s diesel engine, generator, power modules and wheel ends; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.

knowledge.textEn: Normal engine output with weak traction requires generator, converter, motor-current and adhesion checks rather than only more fuel.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在紙面示意、試算表或自行準備的離線教學模型中完成：做四站能量桑基資料表，加入一站效率下降事件；找出在哪個量測邊界最能定位損失。 交付檔請標上 c249、單元 2、輸入條件與資料版本。
knowledge.textEn: Complete in a paper diagram, spreadsheet or separately prepared offline teaching model: Create a four-station energy-flow table, lower one stage efficiency and identify the measurement boundary that best locates the loss. Label the evidence c249, unit 2, input conditions and data version.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
多段效率可以用相加方式得到整體效率。
引擎輸出正常而牽引下降，分查發電、轉換器、馬達限流與附著；不能只增加燃料輸入。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Efficiencies of consecutive stages can be added to obtain overall efficiency.
Normal engine output with weak traction requires generator, converter, motor-current and adhesion checks rather than only more fuel.
quiz.explanation: 引擎輸出正常而牽引下降，分查發電、轉換器、馬達限流與附著；不能只增加燃料輸入。 每一站的功率都要標明電／機械邊界及輔機；核對損失總和等於輸入輸出差，不重複套效率。 將證據連回本案例的 柴油機、發電機、功率模組及輪端，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
quiz.explanationEn: Normal engine output with weak traction requires generator, converter, motor-current and adhesion checks rather than only more fuel. Label electrical/mechanical boundaries and auxiliaries at each station; ensure summed losses equal input minus output without applying efficiency twice. Link evidence to this case’s diesel engine, generator, power modules and wheel ends; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.
